description: Get a structured accessibility tree snapshot of the current page in an active browser session. Returns a hierarchical representation of all visible elements including their roles, names, values, and states — similar to what a screen reader sees. Use this as the primary way to read page content, as it uses 77% fewer tokens than a screenshot. Use this after navigate to understand page structure, find interactive elements by their accessible names, or verify that an action changed the page state. Requires a session created by navigate.

exclude_selectors.description: CSS selectors to exclude from the tree (e.g. ["nav", "footer", ".ad-slot"]). Elements are hidden before snapshotting.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters to return. Truncates at nearest line boundary.

max_depth.description: Maximum tree depth. Limits nesting to get a structural overview without deep details.

selector.description: CSS selector to scope the tree to a specific element (e.g. "#search-results", "main"). If omitted on large pages, auto-scopes to the main landmark.

session_id.description: Browser session ID from a previous navigate call

visible_only.description: Only include visible elements. Skips hidden menus, modals, and offscreen content.

name: get_a11y_tree
